Associated Press (AP) জানিয়েছে, ৩ নভেম্: The Associated Press (AP) reports that Democrats won control of both the U.S. House and Senate in the November 3 midterm elections. Republicans controlled both chambers before the election. According to AP, Democrats won at least seven Republican-held Senate seats; complete seat totals will be updated as counting and certification progress.

দুই কক্ষের নিয়ন্ত্রণ বদলালে নতুন সংখ্যা: When control changes in both chambers, the new majority gains greater influence over hearings, investigations, budgets, and legislation. The president may veto a bill; overriding a veto requires two-thirds support in both the House and Senate. A majority therefore does not guarantee legislation or policy: party unity, congressional rules, courts, and administrative realities also shape outcomes.
এই ফল ডেমোক্র্যাটদের জন্য আইনসভা ও overs: This result creates legislative and oversight opportunities for Democrats and a new context for Republicans’ opposition role and policy accountability. The gap between the two major-party candidates in Michigan was approximately 5.61 percentage points; the state’s formal publication and certification of results are separate processes.
